verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Scribe is a speech-to-text transcription API. It is not an agent or tool-using host, so plugging in MCP servers for it to call is a category error for this kind of product. The official ElevenLabs MCP server in the evidence is the server role, where other agents call ElevenLabs, and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
